preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(s) == n and s.islower() and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 500 000), and the second line is a lowercase Latin string s of length n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and (int(stdout) == max_length) and (max_length == max(len(journey) for journey in valid_journeys))
postconditions.description: stdout is a non-negative integer representing the maximum possible length of a journey on s, where a journey is a sequence of strings t1, ..., tk such that: (1) for each i > 1, ti is a substring of ti-1 and |ti| < |ti-1|; (2) there exists a sequence of strings u1, ..., uk+1 (possibly empty) such that s = u1 t1 u2 t2 ... uk tk uk+1, with ti appearing in order from left to right in s.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout) <= len(s) for s in [stdin.split()[1]])
postconditions.description: The output length is always between 1 and the length of s, inclusive, as a journey must contain at least one substring (the string itself) and cannot exceed the length of s.
